LESSON: TYPES OF DIVORCE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat
Topic 6.1: Types of divorce
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Types of divorce, part of Muamalat in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How can divorce rates be reduced in the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online or on available reference materials for the types of divorce (li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah) and make notes,

2. search and watch or listen to video clips on a talk on the types of divorce (li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah) and write an essay,

3. discuss the differences between li’an, mubarat and faskh nikkah, make charts and present in class

4. brainstorm on the causes of li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present in class,

5. debate on the possible solutions to minimise li’an,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online or on available reference materials for the types of divorce (li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah) and make notes,
2. search and watch or listen to video clips on a talk on the types of divorce (li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah) and write an essay,
3. discuss the differences between li’an, mubarat and faskh nikkah, make charts and present in class
4. brainstorm on the causes of li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present in class,
5. debate on the possible solutions to minimise li’an,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Types of divorce together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: the skills of interacting with digital technology and connecting with technology enhanced as learners search

online the types of divorce (li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah)

● Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork enhanced as learners brainstorm

on the causes of li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present in class

● Learning to learn: the skill of seeking advice enhanced as learners listen to a resource person give a talk on the causes of

li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah and make summary notes

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of networking enhanced as learners debate on the possible solutions to minimise li’an,

mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present in class

Values:
● Responsibility enhanced as learners brainstorm on the causes of li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present in class

● Respect enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinion as they brainstorm on the causes of li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah

in groups and present in class

• Unity enhanced as learners brainstorm on the causes of li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present in class

• Resource mobilisation and utilisation enhanced as learners listen to a resource person give a talk on the causes of li’an,

• Life skills: Self-esteem enhanced as learners brainstorm on the causes of li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present

in class as well as debating on the possible solutions to minimise li’an, mubarat, faskh nikkah in groups and present in class
